v1-22.candidate: From the blood of the wounded, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan’s bow did not turn back empty, and Saul’s sword did not return empty.
v1-22.display:
From the blood of the wounded, from the fat of the mighty,
Jonathan’s bow did not turn back empty,
and Saul’s sword did not return empty.

v1-19.display:
“Set up a memorial, Israel, for the dead, slain upon your heights!
How the mighty have fallen!

v1-20.display:
Do not report it in Gath,
and do not proclaim good news in Ashkelon’s exits,
lest the daughters of the foreigners rejoice,
lest the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.

v1-23.display:
Saul and Jonathan, loved and beautiful, not separated,
splendid in their life and not separated in their death:
swifter than eagles,
they proved stronger than lions.

v1-24.display:
Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul,
who clothed you in scarlet with your adornment,
who put gold adornment upon your clothing.

v1-25.display:
How the mighty have fallen in the midst of war!
Jonathan lies slain upon your heights.

v1-26.display:
I grieve for you, my brother Jonathan.
You were very beautiful to me;
your love for me was wonderful,
beyond the love of women.

v1-27.display:
How the mighty have fallen,
and the equipment of war has perished!”
